title: 1992 AHSME Problem 28
statement: Let \(i=\sqrt{-1}.\) The product of the real parts of the roots of \(z^2-z=5-5i\) is

solutions.text:
The quadratic formula gives \[ z=\frac{1\pm\sqrt{21-20i}}2. \] Since \((5-2i)^2=21-20i,\) the roots are \[ \begin{aligned} \frac{1+(5-2i)}2&=3-i,\\ \frac{1-(5-2i)}2&=-2+i. \end{aligned} \] Their real parts have product \(3(-2)=-6.\)

Thus the correct answer is B.
hints: Apply the quadratic formula and write \(\sqrt{21-20i}=a+bi\)
Solve \(a^2-b^2=21\) and \(2ab=-20\) to determine the real parts of the two roots
